title: Task starfleet/task-agent-templates-schiffsklassen abgeschlossen
subtitle: Ship class templates implemented
body:
Ship class templates implemented and deployed:

- Created internal/config/templates.go with ShipTemplate struct, LoadShipTemplates(), GetTemplate(), ListTemplateNames(), ApplyToLaunchOpts()
- Created .starfleet-ai/conf/templates/templates.yaml with default templates: scout (Nemotron Nano), cruiser (Nemotron Ultra), heavy (Big Pickle)
- Added --template flag to session ship-run command (loads model, launch-type, class from template)
- Added /api/templates endpoint for web UI to fetch template list
- Extended apiShipLaunch to support template parameter (template defaults overridden by explicit flags)
- Templates include: name, description, model, session_type, name_prefix, skills_always, skill_optional, timeout, auto_cleanup

CLI usage:
  starfleetctl session ship-run --template cruiser --name Cruiser-1
  starfleetctl session ship-run --template scout

Web API:
  GET /api/templates → JSON array of templates
  POST /api/ship with {template: "cruiser", name: "Cruiser-1"} → launches ship with template defaults

Tests pass, make all + starfleet-bootstrap + web/timer restart verified.
